BiblicalUsage: Shama is named once, among the sons of Hothan the Aroerite, in the list of David's mighty men. He stands beside his brother Jehiel, and the two names are all Scripture gives us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single name in a list of mighty men is still a place of honour, because God counts the warriors by name.
